title: Split escaped fields without confusing consumed escape characters
goal: Repair split_escaped(text, delimiter=',', escape='\'). Inputs are strings. delimiter and escape must each contain exactly one character and be distinct, otherwise raise ValueError even for empty text. An unescaped delimiter ends a field. An escape consumes and quotes the next character (including another escape, a delimiter, or an ordinary character); remove that escape and retain the quoted character. A final unmatched escape is retained literally. Preserve all empty fields, so empty text returns ['']. Do not modify inputs. Preserve the signature and return a list of strings.
constraints: Do not add files, dependencies, or modify tests.
Keep split_escaped and its signature unchanged.

provenance.hidden_tests: Distinct inputs exercising the same stated specification
